# MICE - Serial vs Sync vs C Plots

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
cutoff <- 0.50

tag         <- sprintf("cutoff%02d", round(cutoff * 100))
results_file <- sprintf("section_4_2_MICE_C_implementation_%s.rds", tag)
log_file     <- sprintf("section_4_2_MICE_C_implementation_%s.txt", tag)

mice <- readRDS(results_file)
```

## Helper Functions

```{r helper_functions, message=FALSE}
report_metrics <- function(true, pred, method_name, elapsed) {
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - true)^2))
  cat(method_name, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Time:  ", round(elapsed, 2), "seconds\n")
  cat("RMSE:  ", rmse, "\n")
  cat("Bias %:", sum(pred - true) / sum(true) * 100, "\n")
  cat("R2:    ", 1 - sum((pred - true)^2) / sum((true - mean(true))^2), "\n")
  cat("SRMSE: ", rmse / mean(true), "\n\n")
}

plot_obs_pred <- function(observed, predicted, method_name = "Method") {
  op <- par(pty = "s")
  on.exit(par(op))
  lims <- range(c(observed, predicted), na.rm = TRUE)
  plot(observed, predicted,
       xlim = lims, ylim = lims,
       xlab = "Observed", ylab = "Predicted",
       main = paste(method_name, ": Observed vs Predicted"),
       pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.12))
  abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
  grid()
}
```

## Unpack

```{r unpack, results='hold'}
meta <- mice$meta
cat("MICE Section 4.2.1\n")
cat("cutoff:", meta$cutoff, " K:", meta$K, " seed:", meta$seed,
    " stations:", meta$n_stations, " observed:", meta$n_observed,
    " n_years:", length(meta$years),
    " years:", paste(meta$years, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
cat("description:", meta$description, "\n")
cat("run_time:   ", format(meta$run_time), "\n")
cat("hostname:   ", meta$hostname, " job:", meta$slurm_job_id,
    " nodelist:", meta$slurm_nodelist, "\n")
cat("R version:  ", meta$r_version, "\n\n")

true_y   <- mice$true_y
serial_y <- mice$serial_y
sync_y   <- mice$sync_y
C_y      <- mice$C_y
```

```{r metrics, results='hold'}
report_metrics(true_y, serial_y, "Serial", mice$serial_time)
report_metrics(true_y, sync_y,   "Synchronous", mice$sync_time)
report_metrics(true_y, C_y,      "C implementation", mice$C_time)
```

## Timings

```{r timings, results='hold'}
serial_time_vec <- mice$serial_time_vec
sync_time_vec   <- mice$sync_time_vec
C_time_vec      <- mice$C_time_vec

cat("Per-fold wall time (s):\n")
print(rbind(serial = round(serial_time_vec, 2),
            sync   = round(sync_time_vec, 2),
            C      = round(C_time_vec, 2)))

speedup_C_serial <- serial_time_vec / C_time_vec
speedup_C_sync   <- sync_time_vec   / C_time_vec
speedup_sync_serial <- serial_time_vec / sync_time_vec

cat("\nPer-fold speedup, mean +/- sd:\n")
cat("C vs serial:   ", round(mean(speedup_C_serial), 2), "+/-", round(sd(speedup_C_serial), 2), "\n")
cat("C vs sync:     ", round(mean(speedup_C_sync), 2), "+/-", round(sd(speedup_C_sync), 2), "\n")
cat("sync vs serial:", round(mean(speedup_sync_serial), 2), "+/-", round(sd(speedup_sync_serial), 2), "\n\n")
```

## Scatterplots

```{r scatterplots, results='hold'}
plot_obs_pred(true_y, serial_y, "Serial")
plot_obs_pred(true_y, sync_y,   "Synchronous")
plot_obs_pred(true_y, C_y,      "C implementation")
```

## RMSE Histories (nested: fold x imputation copy)

```{r rmse_histories, results='hold'}
serial_rmse_list <- mice$serial_rmse_list
sync_rmse_list   <- mice$sync_rmse_list
C_rmse_list      <- mice$C_rmse_list

cat("serial_rmse_list: ", length(serial_rmse_list), "folds x",
    length(serial_rmse_list[[1]]), "imputations (m)\n\n")

cat("Fold 1, serial:\n"); print(serial_rmse_list[[1]])
cat("\nFold 1, sync:\n");   print(sync_rmse_list[[1]])
cat("\nFold 1, C:\n");      print(C_rmse_list[[1]])
```

## Beta History (C implementation only)

```{r beta_structure, results='hold'}
bh <- mice$C_beta_history_list

cat("C_beta_history_list: ", length(bh), "folds\n")
cat("  fold 1: ", length(bh[[1]]), "imputations (m)\n")
cat("  fold 1, imputation 1: ", length(bh[[1]][[1]]), "cycles\n")
cat("  matrix dim: ", paste(dim(bh[[1]][[1]][[1]]), collapse = " x "), "\n\n")
```

```{r beta_heatmap, results='hold'}
last_cycle <- length(bh[[1]][[1]])
b <- bh[[1]][[1]][[last_cycle]]

image(t(b[nrow(b):1, ]), axes = FALSE,
      main = "Beta matrix, fold 1 / imputation 1 / last cycle",
      xlab = "predictor station", ylab = "target station")
box()
```
